items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I like Jason Moran, and I like – the bass player’s son.

ctx.x: Barron – are there any artists today that have caught your ear? I mean, there’s a plethora of musicians. Jason Moran has got a lot, and there’s . . .
Yeah, there’s all of those, but I don’t know enough about them to talk about them. I like Jason Moran, and I like – the bass player’s son. Kimery: John Clayton?

John Clayton’s son, and I like – there’s two other piano players that are around that same age that I like. In time, I think they’re going to develop into something unique. They’re different. I like the fact that these guys – I can’t remember their names. You just named one of them – besides Clayton is the one you named. Kimery: Jason Moran?
